hook: First high-resolution structure of a bacterial conjugation pilus tip reveals a gatekeeper protein.
summary: Bacteria pass DNA to each other through hair-like pili, and the structure of the tip had been unknown. The structure of the R388 pilus tip shows the protein VirB6 sitting at the apex as a gate, plus a previously unknown adhesin called KikA. The authors propose that VirB6 links contact with a recipient cell to opening the channel. The gating mechanism is inferred from a static structure of one system and has not been tested functionally here.
title: Conjugative pilus tip structure reveals convergence in secretion systems
